_about: Leftover Uprising art. Style A (cartoon sticker). Generated with tools/imagegen.py (JTEEF repo), model gpt-image-1.5, quality medium, transparent background except textures. Run: node leftover/tools/makeart.mjs [names...]
style: cute cartoon game sprite, bold dark outline, flat cel shading, thick white sticker border, centered, full body, transparent background, no text
towerStyle: cartoon game sprite of a kitchen tower-defense station, three-quarter top-down view, sitting on a small round countertop base, bold dark outline, flat cel shading, thick white sticker border, centered, transparent background, no text
